        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch a paginated batch of events data with time ranges\n * @param timeRanges Array of time ranges to query\n * @param limit Maximum records per time range\n */\nexport async function getEventsBatched(\n\ttimeRanges: { startYear: number; endYear: number }[],\n\tlimit = 50,\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Ensure we don't query future years\n\t\tconst currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();\n\t\t\n\t\t// Process batches in parallel\n\t\tconst batchPromises = timeRanges.map((range) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t// Adjust each range's end year to not exceed current year\n\t\t\tconst adjustedEndYear = Math.min(range.endYear, currentYear);\n\t\t\treturn getEventsByTimeChunk(range.startYear, adjustedEndYear, limit);\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Stats for the full range\n\t\tconst startYear = Math.min(...timeRanges.map((r) =\u003e r.startYear));\n\t\tconst endYear = Math.max(...timeRanges.map((r) =\u003e r.endYear));\n\t\tconst maxAllowedYear = Math.min(endYear, currentYear);\n\t\t\n\t\tconst statsPromise = getEventsStats(startYear, maxAllowedYear);\n\n\t\t// Wait for all promises to resolve\n\t\tconst [batchResults, stats] = await Promise.all([\n\t\t\tPromise.all(batchPromises),\n\t\t\tstatsPromise,\n\t\t]);\n\n\t\t// Merge all batches\n\t\tconst allEvents = batchResults.flat();\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tevents: allEvents,\n\t\t\tstats,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching batched events:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tevents: [],\n\t\t\tstats: null,\n\t\t};\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch a paginated batch of events data with time ranges\n * @param timeRanges Array of time ranges to query\n * @param limit Maximum records per time range\n */\nexport async function getEventsBatched(\n\ttimeRanges: { startYear: number; endYear: number }[],\n\tlimit = 50,\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Ensure we don't query future years\n\t\tconst currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();\n\t\t\n\t\t// Process batches in parallel\n\t\tconst batchPromises = timeRanges.map((range) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t// Adjust each range's end year to not exceed current year\n\t\t\tconst adjustedEndYear = Math.min(range.endYear, currentYear);\n\t\t\treturn getEventsByTimeChunk(range.startYear, adjustedEndYear, limit);\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Stats for the full range\n\t\tconst startYear = Math.min(...timeRanges.map((r) =\u003e r.startYear));\n\t\tconst endYear = Math.max(...timeRanges.map((r) =\u003e r.endYear));\n\t\tconst maxAllowedYear = Math.min(endYear, currentYear);\n\t\t\n\t\tconst statsPromise = getEventsStats(startYear, maxAllowedYear);\n\n\t\t// Wait for all promises to resolve\n\t\tconst [batchResults, stats] = await Promise.all([\n\t\t\tPromise.all(batchPromises),\n\t\t\tstatsPromise,\n\t\t]);\n\n\t\t// Merge all batches\n\t\tconst allEvents = batchResults.flat();\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tevents: allEvents,\n\t\t\tstats,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching batched events:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tevents: [],\n\t\t\tstats: null,\n\t\t};\n\t}\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for sightings based on time range\n * Uses Xata's search functionality with aggregation to efficiently compute stats\n * @param startDate Starting date for the query (optional, defaults to Jan 1 of startYear)\n * @param endDate Ending date for the query (optional, defaults to Dec 31 of endYear)\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query (used if startDate not provided)\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query (used if endDate not provided)\n */\nexport async function getSightingsStats(\n\tstartDateOrYear: Date | number = 1940,\n\tendDateOrYear: Date | number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n): Promise\u003c{\n\ttotalSightings: number\n\tbyType: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e\n\tbyYear: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e\n\tbyLocation: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e\n\ttimeRange: {\n\t\tstartYear: number\n\t\tendYear: number\n\t}\n}\u003e {\n\t// Initialize these variables at the top level to ensure they're in scope for error handler\n\tlet startYear: number\n\tlet endYear: number\n\n\tif ( startDateOrYear instanceof Date ) {\n\t\tstartYear = startDateOrYear.getFullYear()\n\t} else {\n\t\tstartYear = startDateOrYear\n\t}\n\n\tif ( endDateOrYear instanceof Date ) {\n\t\tendYear = endDateOrYear.getFullYear()\n\t} else {\n\t\tendYear = endDateOrYear\n\t}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for sightings based on time range\n * Uses Xata's search functionality with aggregation to efficiently compute stats\n * @param startDate Starting date for the query (optional, defaults to Jan 1 of startYear)\n * @param endDate Ending date for the query (optional, defaults to Dec 31 of endYear)\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query (used if startDate not provided)\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query (used if endDate not provided)\n */\nexport async function getSightingsStats(\n\tstartDateOrYear: Date | number = 1940,\n\tendDateOrYear: Date | number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n): Promise\u003c{\n\ttotalSightings: number\n\tbyType: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e\n\tbyYear: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e\n\tbyLocation: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e\n\ttimeRange: {\n\t\tstartYear: number\n\t\tendYear: number\n\t}\n}\u003e {\n\t// Initialize these variables at the top level to ensure they're in scope for error handler\n\tlet startYear: number\n\tlet endYear: number\n\n\tif ( startDateOrYear instanceof Date ) {\n\t\tstartYear = startDateOrYear.getFullYear()\n\t} else {\n\t\tstartYear = startDateOrYear\n\t}\n\n\tif ( endDateOrYear instanceof Date ) {\n\t\tendYear = endDateOrYear.getFullYear()\n\t} else {\n\t\tendYear = endDateOrYear\n\t}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for sightings based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality to efficiently compute stats\n */\nexport async function Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's aggregate to get shape distribution\n    const shapesAggregation = await xata.db.sightings\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        shapeDistribution: {\n          distinctCount: {\n            column: 'id',\n            groupBy: 'shape'\n          }\n        }\n      });\n    \n    // Use aggregate for time series data by year\n    const timeSeriesAggregation = await xata.db.sightings\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        sightingsByYear: {\n          count: {\n            groupBy: {\n              dateColumn: 'date',\n              method: 'byYear'\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n    // Aggregate by location\n    const locationAggregation = await xata.db.sightings\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .aggregate({\n        sightingsByLocation: {\n          count: {\n            groupBy: 'city'\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n    return {\n      total: timeSeriesAggregation.aggs.sightingsByYear.reduce(\n        (sum, item) =\u003e sum + item.count, 0\n      ),\n      shapeDistribution: shapesAggregation.aggs.shapeDistribution,\n      timeseriesData: timeSeriesAggregation.aggs.sightingsByYear,\n      locationData: locationAggregation.aggs.sightingsByLocation,\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching sightings stats:', error);\n    return {\n      total: 0,\n      shapeDistribution: [],\n      timeseriesData: [],\n      locationData: [],\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    };\n  }",

+import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
+import { Play, Users, Settings, Terminal, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, X, Clock, CheckCircle, Zap, BarChart3, Eye, Radar, Shield, Star, Target, Globe } from 'lucide-react'
+
+type AlertLevelKey = 'flash' | 'priority' | 'standard' | 'watch'
+type ThreatLevel = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'

+type InvestigationMetrics = {

+type RealTimeAlert = {

+}
+
+type Message = {

+  agent: string
+  action: string

+  timestamp: string
+  status: 'completed' | 'success'
+  output?: {
+    type: string
+    title: string
+    content: string
+    data?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;
+  }
+}
+
+type AgentMap = Record&lt;string, { name: string; icon: string; capabilities: string[]; tier: string }&gt;
+
+type Intelligence = {
+  type: string
+  title: string
+  summary: string
+  status: 'completed'
+  priority: 'critical' | 'high' | 'standard'
+}
+
+type Entity = {

+  name: string
+  type: 'PERSON' | 'ORGANIZATION' | 'EVENT' | 'EVIDENCE'

+  confidence: number
+}
+
+type CredibilityItem = {

+  tier: number

+  evidence: string
+}
+
+const alertLevels: AlertLevelMap = {

+  watch: { name: 'WATCH ALERT', color: 'blue' },
+}
+
+const executionParadigms = {

+  parallel: { name: 'Parallel', description: 'All agents work simultaneously' },

+  collaborative: { name: 'Collaborative', description: 'Agents discuss and iterate together' },
+}
+
+const credibilityTiers = {

+  tier2: { name: 'Tier 2 (7-8)', description: 'Commercial pilots, scientists', threshold: 0.7 },
+  tier3: { name: 'Tier 3 (5-6)', description: 'Multiple civilians', threshold: 0.5 },

+function MonitoringDashboard({ config, alertLevels, investigationMetrics, realTimeAlerts }: MonitoringDashboardProps) {

+                ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700'

+      &lt;div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6"&gt;

+              &lt;div className="bg-white p-3 rounded"&gt;
+                &lt;div className="text-gray-600 text-xs"&gt;Entities&lt;/div&gt;

+              &lt;/div&gt;

+type InvestigationInterfaceProps = {

+  simulateUFOInvestigation: () =&gt; void
+}
+
+function InvestigationInterface({
+  messages,
+  isRunning,
+  ufoAgentTypes,
+  extractedEntities,
+  credibilityAnalysis,
+  agentOutputs,
+  finalIntelligence,
+  prompt,
+  setPrompt,
+  simulateUFOInvestigation,
+}: InvestigationInterfaceProps) {

+      &lt;/div&gt;
+
+      &lt;div className="h-96 border rounded-lg p-4 overflow-y-auto bg-gray-50 mb-4"&gt;
+        {messages.length === 0 &amp;&amp; !isRunning &amp;&amp; (
+          &lt;div className="text-gray-500 text-center mt-20"&gt;Submit a UFO investigation query to begin analysis&lt;/div&gt;
+        )}
+
+        {messages.map((msg) =&gt; (
+          &lt;div key={msg.id} className="mb-3 p-3 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm"&gt;
+            &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1"&gt;

+              &lt;span className="font-medium text-sm"&gt;
+                {msg.agent === 'system' ? '🔧 System' : &#96;${ufoAgentTypes[msg.agent]?.icon} ${ufoAgentTypes[msg.agent]?.name}&#96;}

+            &lt;/div&gt;
+            &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-700"&gt;{msg.message}&lt;/p&gt;
+            {msg.output &amp;&amp; (

+                    {msg.output.type.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}
+                  &lt;/span&gt;
+                  &lt;span className="text-sm font-medium"&gt;{msg.output.title}&lt;/span&gt;
+                &lt;/div&gt;
+                &lt;div className="text-xs text-gray-600 bg-gray-50 rounded p-2 max-h-32 overflow-y-auto"&gt;
+                  &lt;pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap"&gt;{msg.output.content}&lt;/pre&gt;
+                &lt;/div&gt;
+              &lt;/div&gt;
+            )}
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        ))}
+
+        {isRunning &amp;&amp; (
+          &lt;div className="mb-3 p-3 bg-purple-50 rounded-lg"&gt;
+            &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+              &lt;div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-4 w-4 border-2 border-purple-600 border-t-transparent"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+              &lt;span className="text-sm text-purple-700"&gt;UFO analysis agents investigating...&lt;/span&gt;
+            &lt;/div&gt;
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        )}
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+
+      {(extractedEntities.length &gt; 0 || credibilityAnalysis.length &gt; 0 || finalIntelligence.length &gt; 0) &amp;&amp; (
+        &lt;div className="mt-6 border-t pt-6"&gt;
+          &lt;h4 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4 flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+            &lt;Star className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600" /&gt;
+            Investigation Results
+          &lt;/h4&gt;
+
+          {extractedEntities.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+            &lt;div className="mb-6"&gt;
+              &lt;h5 className="font-medium mb-3"&gt;Extracted Entities&lt;/h5&gt;
+              &lt;div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3"&gt;
+                {extractedEntities.map((entity) =&gt; (
+                  &lt;div key={entity.id} className="border rounded-lg p-3 bg-gray-50"&gt;
+                    &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2"&gt;
+                      &lt;span
+                        className={&#96;text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-medium ${
+                          entity.type === 'PERSON'
+                            ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
+                            : entity.type === 'ORGANIZATION'
+                            ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800'
+                            : entity.type === 'EVENT'
+                            ? 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800'
+                            : 'bg-red-100 text-red-800'
+                        }&#96;}
+                      &gt;
+                        {entity.type}
+                      &lt;/span&gt;
+                      &lt;span className="text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;{(entity.credibility * 100).toFixed(0)}% credible&lt;/span&gt;
+                    &lt;/div&gt;
+                    &lt;h6 className="font-medium text-sm mb-1"&gt;{entity.name}&lt;/h6&gt;
+                    &lt;div className="text-xs text-gray-600"&gt;Confidence: {(entity.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%&lt;/div&gt;
+                  &lt;/div&gt;
+                ))}
+              &lt;/div&gt;
+            &lt;/div&gt;
+          )}
+
+          {credibilityAnalysis.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+            &lt;div className="mb-6"&gt;
+              &lt;h5 className="font-medium mb-3"&gt;Credibility Assessment Matrix&lt;/h5&gt;
+              &lt;div className="space-y-2"&gt;
+                {credibilityAnalysis.map((item) =&gt; (
+                  &lt;div key={item.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 border rounded-lg bg-white"&gt;
+                    &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3"&gt;
+                      &lt;div
+                        className={&#96;w-3 h-3 rounded-full ${
+                          item.tier === 1
+                            ? 'bg-green-500'
+                            : item.tier === 2
+                            ? 'bg-blue-500'
+                            : item.tier === 3
+                            ? 'bg-yellow-500'
+                            : item.tier === 4
+                            ? 'bg-orange-500'
+                            : 'bg-red-500'
+                        }&#96;}
+                      &gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+                      &lt;div&gt;
+                        &lt;span className="text-sm font-medium"&gt;{item.source}&lt;/span&gt;
+                        &lt;div className="text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;{item.evidence}&lt;/div&gt;
+                      &lt;/div&gt;
+                    &lt;/div&gt;
+                    &lt;div className="text-right"&gt;
+                      &lt;div className="text-sm font-bold"&gt;{(item.credibility * 100).toFixed(0)}%&lt;/div&gt;
+                      &lt;div className="text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;Tier {item.tier}&lt;/div&gt;
+                    &lt;/div&gt;
+                  &lt;/div&gt;
+                ))}
+              &lt;/div&gt;
+            &lt;/div&gt;
+          )}
+
+          {agentOutputs.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+            &lt;div className="mb-6"&gt;
+              &lt;h5 className="font-medium mb-3"&gt;Specialized Agent Outputs&lt;/h5&gt;
+              &lt;div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4"&gt;
+                {agentOutputs.map((output, index) =&gt; (
+                  &lt;div key={index} className="border rounded-lg p-4 bg-gray-50"&gt;
+                    &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2"&gt;
+                      &lt;span className="text-sm font-medium flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+                        {ufoAgentTypes[output.agent]?.icon} {ufoAgentTypes[output.agent]?.name}
+                      &lt;/span&gt;
+                      &lt;span className="text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;{output.timestamp}&lt;/span&gt;
+                    &lt;/div&gt;
+                    &lt;h6 className="font-medium text-sm mb-1"&gt;{output.title}&lt;/h6&gt;
+                    &lt;p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mb-2"&gt;{output.content.substring(0, 200)}...&lt;/p&gt;
+                    {output.data &amp;&amp; Object.keys(output.data).length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+                      &lt;div className="text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;
+                        &lt;strong&gt;Key Data:&lt;/strong&gt;{' '}
+                        {Object.entries(output.data)
+                          .slice(0, 3)
+                          .map(([key, value]) =&gt; &#96;${key}: ${String(value)}&#96;)
+                          .join(', ')}
+                      &lt;/div&gt;
+                    )}
+                  &lt;/div&gt;
+                ))}
+              &lt;/div&gt;
+            &lt;/div&gt;
+          )}
+
+          {finalIntelligence.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+            &lt;div&gt;
+              &lt;h5 className="font-medium mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+                &lt;Globe className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
+                Final Intelligence Reports
+              &lt;/h5&gt;
+              &lt;div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3"&gt;
+                {finalIntelligence.map((intel, index) =&gt; (
+                  &lt;div key={index} className="border rounded-lg p-3 bg-white"&gt;
+                    &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"&gt;
+                      &lt;span
+                        className={&#96;text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-medium ${
+                          intel.priority === 'critical'
+                            ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-800'
+                            : intel.priority === 'high'
+                            ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800'
+                            : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
+                        }&#96;}
+                      &gt;
+                        {intel.type.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}
+                      &lt;/span&gt;
+                      &lt;CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" /&gt;
+                    &lt;/div&gt;
+                    &lt;h6 className="font-medium text-sm mb-1"&gt;{intel.title}&lt;/h6&gt;
+                    &lt;p className="text-xs text-gray-600"&gt;{intel.summary}&lt;/p&gt;
+                  &lt;/div&gt;
+                ))}
+              &lt;/div&gt;
+            &lt;/div&gt;
+          )}
+        &lt;/div&gt;
+      )}
+
+      &lt;div className="flex gap-2"&gt;
+        &lt;input
+          type="text"
+          value={prompt}
+          onChange={(e) =&gt; setPrompt(e.target.value)}
+          placeholder="Enter UFO investigation query (e.g., 'Analyze the USS Nimitz encounter', 'Pattern analysis for 2004 incidents')..."
+          className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"
+          disabled={isRunning}
+        /&gt;
+        &lt;button
+          onClick={simulateUFOInvestigation}
+          disabled={isRunning || !prompt.trim()}
+          className="px-4 py-2 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-purple-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center gap-2"
+        &gt;
+          &lt;Play className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
+          Investigate
+        &lt;/button&gt;
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+    &lt;/div&gt;
+  )
+}
+
+type TerminalInterfaceProps = {
+  config: { numAgents: number; credibilityThreshold: number; alertLevel: AlertLevelKey }
+  messages: Message[]
+  isRunning: boolean
+  prompt: string
+  setPrompt: (v: string) =&gt; void
+  currentStep: number
+  simulateUFOInvestigation: () =&gt; void
+}
+
+function TerminalInterface({ config, messages, isRunning, prompt, setPrompt, currentStep, simulateUFOInvestigation }: TerminalInterfaceProps) {
+  return (
+    &lt;div className="bg-gray-900 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 text-green-400 font-mono"&gt;
+      &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4"&gt;
+        &lt;Terminal className="w-5 h-5" /&gt;
+        &lt;h3 className="text-lg font-semibold"&gt;UFO Research Terminal&lt;/h3&gt;
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+
+      &lt;div className="h-96 bg-black rounded p-4 overflow-y-auto text-sm"&gt;
+        &lt;div className="text-green-300 mb-2"&gt;$ UFO Research Orchestration System v3.0&lt;/div&gt;
+        &lt;div className="text-green-300 mb-4"&gt;
+          Initialized with {config.numAgents} agents | Credibility threshold: {config.credibilityThreshold} | Alert level: {config.alertLevel}
+        &lt;/div&gt;
+
+        {messages.map((msg) =&gt; (
+          &lt;div key={msg.id} className="mb-2"&gt;
+            &lt;span className="text-yellow-400"&gt;[{msg.timestamp}]&lt;/span&gt;
+            &lt;span className="text-blue-400"&gt; {msg.agent}:&lt;/span&gt;
+            &lt;span className="text-green-400"&gt; {msg.message}&lt;/span&gt;
+            {msg.output &amp;&amp; msg.output.data &amp;&amp; (
+              &lt;div className="ml-4 text-cyan-400 text-xs"&gt;
+                Data: {Object.entries(msg.output.data)
+                  .slice(0, 2)
+                  .map(([k, v]) =&gt; &#96;${k}=${String(v)}&#96;)
+                  .join(', ')}
+              &lt;/div&gt;
+            )}
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        ))}
+
+        {isRunning &amp;&amp; (
+          &lt;div className="text-yellow-400 animate-pulse"&gt;
+            &lt;span className="mr-1"&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt; Executing UFO investigation step {currentStep + 1}...
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        )}
+
+        {!isRunning &amp;&amp; (
+          &lt;div className="mt-4"&gt;
+            &lt;span className="text-green-300"&gt;ufo-research$ &lt;/span&gt;
+            &lt;input
+              type="text"
+              value={prompt}
+              onChange={(e) =&gt; setPrompt(e.target.value)}
+              placeholder="investigate &lt;query&gt;"
+              className="bg-transparent outline-none text-green-400 flex-1"
+              disabled={isRunning}
+              onKeyDown={(e) =&gt; e.key === 'Enter' &amp;&amp; simulateUFOInvestigation()}
+            /&gt;
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        )}
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+    &lt;/div&gt;
+  )
+}
+
+export function UFOResearchOrchestrator() {
+  const [config, setConfig] = useState({
+    numAgents: 4,
+    selectedAgents: ['master-orchestrator', 'evidence-evaluator', 'historical-analyst', 'ner-extractor'],
+    executionParadigm: 'hierarchical' as keyof typeof executionParadigms,
+    roles: {} as Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;,
+    scenario: 'ufo-investigation',
+    credibilityThreshold: 0.7,
+    alertLevel: 'standard' as AlertLevelKey,
+  })
+
+  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false)
+  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(0)
+  const [uiMode, setUiMode] = useState&lt;'investigation' | 'terminal'&gt;('investigation')
+  const [messages, setMessages] = useState&lt;Message[]&gt;([])
+  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState('')
+  const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState({ agents: true, credibility: true, roles: true })
+
+  const [investigationMetrics, setInvestigationMetrics] = useState&lt;InvestigationMetrics&gt;({
+    documentsAnalyzed: 0,
+    entitiesExtracted: 0,
+    credibilityScore: 0,
+    hoaxIndicators: 0,
+    witnessesVerified: 0,
+    patternsDetected: 0,
+    physicalEvidence: 0,
+    governmentSources: 0,
+    correlationScore: 0,
+    threatLevel: 'low',
+  })
+
+  const [realTimeAlerts, setRealTimeAlerts] = useState&lt;RealTimeAlert[]&gt;([])
+  const [extractedEntities, setExtractedEntities] = useState&lt;Entity[]&gt;([])
+  const [credibilityAnalysis, setCredibilityAnalysis] = useState&lt;CredibilityItem[]&gt;([])
+  const [agentOutputs, setAgentOutputs] = useState&lt;{
+    agent: string
+    step: number
+    timestamp: string
+    title: string
+    content: string
+    data?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;
+  }[]&gt;([])
+  const [finalIntelligence, setFinalIntelligence] = useState&lt;Intelligence[]&gt;([])
+
+  useEffect(() =&gt; {
+    if (config.selectedAgents.includes('real-time-monitor')) {
+      const interval = setInterval(() =&gt; {
+        const alerts: RealTimeAlert[] = [
+          { id: Date.now(), type: 'sighting', location: 'Phoenix, AZ', credibility: 0.85, time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString() },
+          { id: Date.now() + 1, type: 'radar', location: 'RAF Lakenheath', credibility: 0.92, time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString() },
+        ]
+
+        if (Math.random() &gt; 0.8) {
+          setRealTimeAlerts((prev) =&gt; [alerts[Math.floor(Math.random() * alerts.length)], ...prev.slice(0, 3)])
+        }
+      }, 15000)
+
+      return () =&gt; clearInterval(interval)
+    }
+  }, [config.selectedAgents])
+
+  function toggleSection(section: keyof typeof expandedSections) {
+    setExpandedSections((prev) =&gt; ({ ...prev, [section]: !prev[section] }))
+  }
+
+  function updateConfig&lt;K extends keyof typeof config&gt;(key: K, value: (typeof config)[K]) {
+    setConfig((prev) =&gt; {
+      const newConfig = { ...prev, [key]: value }
+
+      if (key === 'scenario' &amp;&amp; ufoScenarios[String(value)]) {
+        const scenario = ufoScenarios[String(value)]
+        newConfig.selectedAgents = scenario.defaultAgents
+        newConfig.numAgents = scenario.defaultAgents.length
+        newConfig.executionParadigm = scenario.defaultParadigm
+      }
+
+      return newConfig
+    })
+  }
+
+  function addAgent(agentType: string) {
+    if (!config.selectedAgents.includes(agentType)) {
+      setConfig((prev) =&gt; ({ ...prev, selectedAgents: [...prev.selectedAgents, agentType], numAgents: prev.numAgents + 1 }))
+    }
+  }
+
+  function removeAgent(agentType: string) {
+    setConfig((prev) =&gt; ({ ...prev, selectedAgents: prev.selectedAgents.filter((a) =&gt; a !== agentType), numAgents: prev.numAgents - 1 }))
+  }
+
+  function generateUFOOutput(agent: string, step: number, query: string) {
+    const outputs: Record&lt;string, { type: string; title: string; content: string; data?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; }&gt; = {
+      'master-orchestrator': {
+        type: 'orchestration_analysis',
+        title: 'Master Orchestration Assessment',
+        content: &#96;🎯 Strategic Analysis for: "${query}"\n\nQuery Classification:\n• Complexity Level: ${Math.random() &gt; 0.5 ? 'High' : 'Medium'}\n• Credibility Threshold: ${config.credibilityThreshold}\n• Alert Priority: ${config.alertLevel.toUpperCase()}\n\nAgent Deployment:\n• ${config.selectedAgents.length} specialized agents activated\n• Execution paradigm: ${config.executionParadigm}\n• Quality control: Enhanced credibility framework\n\nInitial Assessment:\n• Government involvement: ${Math.random() &gt; 0.6 ? 'Detected' : 'None'}\n• Historical pattern match: ${Math.random() &gt; 0.4 ? 'Confirmed' : 'Analyzing'}\n• Hoax probability: ${(Math.random() * 0.3).toFixed(2)} (Low risk)&#96;,
+        data: { agentsDeployed: config.selectedAgents.length, credibilityFramework: 'active', hoaxRisk: (Math.random() * 0.3).toFixed(2) },
+      },
+      'evidence-evaluator': {
+        type: 'evidence_analysis',
+        title: 'Forensic Evidence Assessment',
+        content: &#96;🔬 Evidence Evaluation Report for: "${query}"\n\nEvidence Hierarchy Analysis:\n• Tier 1 (Physical): ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)} items\n• Tier 2 (Sensor): ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)} data points\n• Tier 3 (Visual): ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 8)} media files\n• Tier 4 (Witness): ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 12)} testimonies\n• Tier 5 (Documentary): ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 6)} documents\n\nAuthentication Results:\n• Chain of custody: ${Math.random() &gt; 0.7 ? 'Verified' : 'Partial'}\n• Metadata integrity: ${(Math.random() * 100).toFixed(1)}% authentic\n• Hoax indicators: ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)} flags\n• Expert credibility: ${(0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3).toFixed(2)}&#96;,
+        data: { evidenceItems: Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 5, authenticationScore: (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3).toFixed(2), hoaxFlags: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) },
+      },
+      'historical-analyst': {
+        type: 'historical_correlation',
+        title: 'Historical Pattern Analysis',
+        content: &#96;📚 Historical Analysis for: "${query}"\n\nDatabase Cross-Reference:\n• Project Blue Book matches: ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 8)} cases\n• MUFON database correlation: ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 15)} reports\n• NUFORC pattern analysis: ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 12)} matches\n• Declassified documents: ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)} FOIA releases\n\nHistorical Context:\n• Flap period correlation: ${Math.random() &gt; 0.6 ? '1967 Wave' : '1973 Wave'}\n• Witness patterns: ${Math.random() &gt; 0.5 ? 'Military personnel' : 'Civilian pilots'}\n• Geographic status: ${Math.random() &gt; 0.4 ? 'Known hotspot' : 'New location'}\n• Technology progression: ${Math.random() &gt; 0.7 ? 'Advanced' : 'Standard'}&#96;,
+        data: { bluebookMatches: Math.floor(Math.random() * 8), mufonCorrelations: Math.floor(Math.random() * 15), foiaDocuments: Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) },
+      },
+      'ner-extractor': {
+        type: 'entity_extraction',
+        title: 'Advanced Entity Extraction Results',
+        content: &#96;🗃️ NER Analysis for: "${query}"\n\nEntity Extraction Summary:\n• Personnel/Witnesses: ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 12) + 3} identified\n• Events/Sightings: ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 8) + 2} catalogued\n• Organizations: ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1} mapped\n• Locations: ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 2} geotagged\n• Evidence/Artifacts: ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 1} documented\n\nCredibility Scoring:\n• Average credibility: ${(0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4).toFixed(2)}\n• Source reliability: ${(0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3).toFixed(2)}\n• Cross-validation: ${(Math.random() * 100).toFixed(1)}% confirmed\n• Relationship confidence: ${(0.8 + Math.random() * 0.2).toFixed(2)}&#96;,
+        data: { entitiesExtracted: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) + 20, credibilityAverage: (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4).toFixed(2), relationships: Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) + 15 },
+      },
+    }
+
+    return (
+      outputs[agent] || {
+        type: 'generic_ufo_output',
+        title: 'UFO Analysis Output',
+        content: &#96;${ufoAgentTypes[agent]?.name || 'Agent'} completed analysis for: "${query}"&#96;,
+        data: {},
+      }
+    )
+  }
+
+  async function simulateUFOInvestigation() {
+    setIsRunning(true)
+    setCurrentStep(0)
+    setMessages([])
+    setAgentOutputs([])
+    setFinalIntelligence([])
+    setExtractedEntities([])
+    setCredibilityAnalysis([])
+
+    setInvestigationMetrics({
+      documentsAnalyzed: Math.floor(Math.random() * 50) + 10,
+      entitiesExtracted: Math.floor(Math.random() * 100) + 25,
+      credibilityScore: Number((0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4).toFixed(2)),
+      hoaxIndicators: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3),
+      witnessesVerified: Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) + 5,
+      patternsDetected: Math.floor(Math.random() * 8) + 2,
+      physicalEvidence: Math.floor(Math.random() * 5),
+      governmentSources: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3),
+      correlationScore: Number((Math.random() * 100).toFixed(1)),
+      threatLevel: Math.random() &gt; 0.8 ? 'high' : Math.random() &gt; 0.5 ? 'medium' : 'low',
+    })
+
+    const steps = generateUFOExecutionSteps()
+
+    for (let i = 0; i &lt; steps.length; i++) {
+      setCurrentStep(i)
+      await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 2000))
+
+      const agentOutput = generateUFOOutput(steps[i].agent, i + 1, prompt)
+
+      setMessages((prev) =&gt; [
+        ...prev,
+        {
+          id: Date.now() + i,
+          step: i + 1,
+          agent: steps[i].agent,
+          action: steps[i].action,
+          message: steps[i].message,
+          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
+          status: 'completed',
+          output: agentOutput,
+        },
+      ])
+
+      if (steps[i].agent !== 'system') {
+        setAgentOutputs((prev) =&gt; [
+          ...prev,
+          {
+            ...agentOutput,
+            agent: steps[i].agent,
+            step: i + 1,
+            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
+          },
+        ])
+      }
+
+      if (steps[i].agent === 'ner-extractor') {
+        const entities: Entity[] = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, idx) =&gt; ({
+          id: Date.now() + idx,
+          name: ['David Fravor', 'USS Nimitz', 'Tic Tac Object', 'FLIR1 Video', 'Chad Underwood'][idx] as string,
+          type: ['PERSON', 'ORGANIZATION', 'EVENT', 'EVIDENCE', 'PERSON'][idx] as Entity['type'],
+          credibility: Number((0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5).toFixed(2)),
+          confidence: Number((0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3).toFixed(2)),
+        }))
+        setExtractedEntities(entities)
+      }
+
+      if (steps[i].agent === 'evidence-evaluator') {
+        const credibilityData: CredibilityItem[] = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, idx) =&gt; ({
+          id: idx,
+          source: ['Military Pilot', 'Radar Operator', 'Commercial Pilot', 'Civilian Witness', 'Anonymous Report'][idx] as string,
+          tier: idx + 1,
+          credibility: [0.95, 0.85, 0.75, 0.45, 0.15][idx] as number,
+          evidence: ['Flight logs, radar data', 'Technical recordings', 'Professional testimony', 'Cell phone video', 'Social media post'][idx] as string,
+        }))
+        setCredibilityAnalysis(credibilityData)
+      }
+    }
+
+    const intelligence: Intelligence[] = [
+      {
+        type: 'final_synthesis',
+        title: 'Comprehensive UFO Intelligence Report',
+        summary: &#96;Complete multi-agent UFO investigation with ${config.selectedAgents.length} specialized analysts&#96;,
+        status: 'completed',
+        priority: 'critical',
+      },
+    ]
+    setFinalIntelligence(intelligence)
+
+    setIsRunning(false)
+    setMessages((prev) =&gt; [
+      ...prev,

+        id: Date.now(),
+        step: steps.length + 1,
+        agent: 'system',

+        message: &#96;UFO investigation completed! Generated intelligence reports from ${config.selectedAgents.length} specialized agents.&#96;,
+        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),

+      },

+
+  function generateUFOExecutionSteps() {

+    const agents = config.selectedAgents

+    if (agents.includes('master-orchestrator')) {

+        steps.push({ agent, action: 'execute', message: &#96;${ufoAgentTypes[agent].name} conducting specialized UFO analysis...&#96; })
+      })
+
+    return steps
+  }
+

After reviewing the `package.json` files, the problem is clear:
